name: QMD
description: Indexes local markdown notes, meeting transcripts, and docs for on-device BM25, vector, and LLM-reranked hybrid search, exposed to agents through a CLI, an MCP server, and a Node SDK.

skills.name: Hybrid Query
skills.description: Searches with typed lex, vec, and HyDE sub-queries, fuses BM25 and vector results with reciprocal rank fusion, then reranks with an LLM.

skills.name: Collections And Context
skills.description: Groups folders into named collections and attaches a tree of context descriptions that come back with matching documents in results.

skills.name: Document Retrieval
skills.description: Fetches a document by path or docid with fuzzy suggestions, or batches retrieval by glob pattern, list, or docids with multi-get.

skills.name: HTTP MCP Daemon
skills.description: Serves the query, get, multi_get, status, and metadata tools over stdio or as a long-lived HTTP daemon that avoids reloading models.
